description: Every result file written under results/eval/ records per-run provenance metadata so that tables and figures are reproducible and independently auditable.

field_notes.command: Exact CLI invocation that produced the file.
field_notes.model: Live model id(s), e.g. gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5.4-nano.
field_notes.seed: Deterministic seed for scenario generation and bootstrap.
field_notes.dataset_hash: sha256 of the input dataset JSON.
field_notes.request_hash: sha256 of the canonicalized request payload(s).
field_notes.response_hash: sha256 of the raw response payload(s).
field_notes.scenario_family: One of: twin_run, pause_resume, superseded_policy, branch_merge, artifact_handoff, private_summary, long_horizon_drift, audit_reconstruction (plus SE-native families).
field_notes.protocol_condition: Condition id, e.g. C4, C5/acmcp-core, C4+all-static-filters.

metric_definitions.FFCR: Failure-Free Completion Rate: completed AND no wrong-scope/stale/unauthorized memory use AND no missing critical memory AND final decision reconstructable from event graph.
